shiftModel.name: three-shift rotation
shiftModel.note: Primary duty assignment only. Emergencies, training, leave, watches and mission needs override normal rotation.

materializationPolicy.tier1: Core persistent NPCs: senior officers and people who become personally important. Full hidden characterization belongs in private GM state.
materializationPolicy.tier2: Persistent named crew: stable public identity, rank, department, billet and service facts.
materializationPolicy.tier3: Background population represented statistically until interaction makes a stable identity useful.
materializationPolicy.rule: Once a background person is materialized, the identity is never silently regenerated.

assignmentPolicy.playerShift: Determined during character creation / department onboarding rather than assumed in advance.
assignmentPolicy.playerDepartment: Determined by chosen specialty and billet.
assignmentPolicy.promotionAndTransfer: Do not rewrite nominal department totals silently; personnel changes are campaign events.
